title: A US FTC official says Shein agreed to pay $100M to settle US claims that it misled consumers on shipping times, manipulated product reviews, and more (Jody Godoy/Reuters)
summary: Jody Godoy / Reuters: A US FTC official says Shein agreed to pay $100M to settle US claims that it misled consumers on shipping times, manipulated product reviews, and more — Chinese fast-fashion giant Shein (0625.HK) will pay $100 million to settle US claims that it misled consumers on shipping times …
